spots.title: Before touching a patient
spots.text: Protects the patient from germs on your hands. Example: before taking a pulse or helping them sit up.

spots.title: Before a clean / aseptic procedure
spots.text: Protects the patient from germs entering their body. Example: before giving an injection or handling a catheter.

spots.title: After body fluid exposure risk
spots.text: Protects you and the ward. Example: after taking blood or emptying a urine bag — even if you wore gloves.

spots.title: After touching a patient
spots.text: Protects you and the next patient. Example: after a bed bath or examining the patient.

spots.title: After touching patient surroundings
spots.text: Protects the next patient. Example: after changing bed linen or adjusting the IV pump — even if you did not touch the patient.
